article_content: Once recognized mainly for its vibrant casinos and nightlife, Las Vegas is rapidly building a new reputation as a dynamic sports hub. Over the past decade, the city has attracted top-tier teams, including the MLB's Athletics and the Ultimate Fighting Championship, and has become a destination for prominent events like NCAA tournaments, NFL Pro Bowls, and the upcoming Super Bowl LVIII. Several more sports venues are under consideration, and Vegas is now a frontrunner for NBA and MLS expansion teams. This evolution promises major economic benefits. Early projections placed the Formula 1 Grand Prix and 2024 Super Bowl’s impact at $1.3 billion and $500 million, respectively—though F1 ticket prices dropped after the season championship was settled. Major events are attracting attention and new visitors, but they're also fueling local frustrations over traffic gridlocks, soaring prices, and limited views caused by temporary infrastructure. Andrew Woods from UNLV’s Center for Business and Economic Research points out that while Las Vegas has become a magnet for professional leagues, some communities are still left out, experiencing what he calls 'sports deserts' with poor access to sports facilities. Addressing this uneven benefit is an emerging challenge. For years, pro leagues avoided Las Vegas due to concerns over its gambling scene. That changed around 2017, as leagues like the NHL and Raiders saw opportunity in the city’s shifting image. As NFL commissioner Roger Goodell noted, Las Vegas is now an entertainment hotspot with a much broader appeal. After the Supreme Court overturned federal restrictions in 2018, sports betting took off nationwide, but Las Vegas maintained its role at the heart of the industry—home to leading casino and betting operators like FanDuel. Sports are drawing new types of visitors to the city. A 2022 profile showed sporting event attendance among tourists has doubled since 2019, and more people cite sports as their primary reason to visit. Despite the rise of sports, leisure and hospitality remain central, employing a quarter of local workers and bringing in a third of Clark County’s revenue. Sports are helping diversify Las Vegas’s economic mix. The number of sports instruction businesses is up 156% in the past decade, and youth sports—especially for girls—are thriving. As Las Vegas’s reputation shifts, city leaders see promise in sports-driven growth but acknowledge issues like infrastructure strain, high costs, and unequal access need addressing. Even so, they see sports helping stabilize and grow the city’s economy, giving more people new reasons to visit and invest.

Az elmúlt tíz évben a város első osztályú csapatokat csábított magához – köztük az MLB Athletics-et és az Ultimate Fighting Championship-et –, és rangos eseményeket rendez, például NCAA tornákat, NFL Pro Bowlokat és a közelgő Super Bowl LVIII-t. További sportlétesítmények is tervben vannak, és Vegas most az NBA és az MLS bővítésének egyik legesélyesebb helyszíne. Ez a fejlemény komoly gazdasági lehetőségeket jelent. A Formula 1-es Grand Prix és a 2024-es Super Bowl előzetes becslések szerint 1,3 milliárd, illetve 500 millió dollárt hozhat a városnak – igaz, az F1 jegyárai csökkentek, miután idő előtt eldőlt a bajnoki cím. Ezek az események rengeteg új vendéget vonzanak, de komoly elégedetlenséget is okoznak a helyiek között a forgalmi dugók, a megemelkedett árak és a látványosságokat eltakarással fenyegető ideiglenes építmények miatt. Andrew Woods, a UNLV Gazdaságkutató Központjának igazgatója kiemeli, hogy bár Las Vegas most vonzza a profi ligákat, egyes városrészek – az úgynevezett „sport sivatagok” – még mindig hátrányt szenvednek, mert kevés a sportolási lehetőségük. Ezeknek az egyenlőtlenségeknek a kezelése komoly feladat lesz. Sokáig a profi sportszervezetek kerülni igyekeztek Las Vegast a szerencsejáték miatt. Ez 2017 körül kezdett változni, amikor olyan ligák, mint az NHL vagy a Raiders is lehetőséget láttak a városban. Roger Goodell NFL-elnök szerint Vegas ma már igazi szórakoztató központ lett. A sport egyre inkább sokszínűvé teszi Las Vegas gazdaságát is: az elmúlt tíz évben 156%-kal nőtt a sportszolgáltatásokkal foglalkozó vállalkozások száma, miközben a fiatalok sportolási hajlandósága – főleg a lányoké – jelentősen nőtt. Miközben a város arculata változik, a döntéshozók komoly lehetőséget látnak a sport által hajtott fejlődésben, de elismerik, hogy az infrastruktúra terhelése, a magas árak és az egyenlőtlen hozzáférés kihívást jelent. Ugyanakkor úgy gondolják: a sport hosszú távon stabilabbá és vonzóbbá teheti Las Vegas gazdaságát, több indokot és lehetőséget biztosítva az ide látogatóknak.

article_content: The SpaceX-29 commercial resupply spacecraft will deliver a variety of physical sciences and space biology experiments, as well as other cargo, to the International Space Station (ISS). This mission's research will support scientists in learning how humans and the plants that sustain them can thrive during extended space missions. The key biological and physical sciences investigations on this mission are: Plant Water Management-5 and 6 (PWM-5 and 6): NASA has successfully grown plants on the ISS even in the absence of gravity. However, microgravity creates challenges for ensuring adequate hydration and nutrition for these plants. The PWM-5 and 6 experiments use the properties of fluids, such as surface tension and wetting, to deliver water and air to plants. This could improve our understanding of fluid flow in low gravity and lead to better fluid delivery systems for future missions. Plant Habitat-06 (PH-06): This experiment explores whether being in space affects how tomato plants defend themselves against bacteria and fungi. It examines whether the hormone salicylic acid is involved in plant immune responses under microgravity. The findings may help develop ways to reduce crop loss and improve food quality for future space agriculture. Rodent Research-20 (RR-20): Understanding the effects of spaceflight on reproductive health is critical for long missions to the Moon or Mars. Previous missions have found changes in ovarian function in female mice that may impact fertility. RR-20 will further study whether these changes are temporary or permanent, and if disrupted hormone signaling may also be linked to bone loss. Bacterial Adhesion and Corrosion (BAC): This joint biology and physical sciences experiment studies how groups of different bacteria (biofilms) behave in microgravity. Biofilms can resist standard cleaning and contaminate water systems, posing astronaut health risks. The study will identify genes involved in biofilm growth, test if these biofilms can corrode stainless steel, and assess how well silver-based disinfectants work. Information provided by NASA. Citation: Experiments launching aboard SpaceX-29 will help humans go farther and stay longer in space (2023, November 10). translated_content: A SpaceX-29 kereskedelmi teherűrhajó számos fizikai és űrbiológiai kísérletet, valamint egyéb rakományt szállít majd a Nemzetközi Űrállomásra (ISS). A küldetés kutatásai segítenek a tudósoknak megérteni, hogyan élhetnek túl az emberek és az őket ellátó növények hosszabb űrutazások során. A küldetés fő biológiai és fizikai tudományos vizsgálatait az alábbiak alkotják: Plant Water Management-5 és 6 (PWM-5 és 6): A NASA már sikeresen nevelt növényeket az ISS-en a gravitáció hiányában is. Azonban a mikrogravitáció kihívásokat jelent a növények megfelelő hidratálása és tápanyag-ellátása terén. A PWM-5 és 6 kísérletek a folyadékok, például a felületi feszültség és a nedvesedés tulajdonságait használják fel a növények víz- és levegőellátásának biztosítására. Ez javíthatja a folyadékáramlás megértését alacsony gravitációban, és fejlettebb folyadékszállító rendszerekhez vezethet. Plant Habitat-06 (PH-06): Ez a kísérlet azt vizsgálja, hogy a világűrben való tartózkodás hogyan befolyásolja a paradicsom növények védekezését a baktériumokkal és gombákkal szemben. Megvizsgálja, hogy a szalicilsav hormon részt vesz-e a növényi immunválaszban mikrogravitáció során. Az eredmények segíthetnek csökkenteni a terméskiesést és javítani az élelmiszerminőséget a jövő űrmezőgazdaságában. Rodent Research-20 (RR-20): Az űrutazás hatásainak megértése a reproduktív egészségre kulcsfontosságú a hosszú hold- vagy marsi missziókhoz. Korábbi kísérletek változásokat találtak nőstény egerek petefészek-működésében, amelyek befolyásolhatják a termékenységet. Az RR-20 tovább vizsgálja, hogy ezek a változások átmenetiek vagy tartósak-e, illetve hogy a hormonális szabályozás zavara összefügghet-e a csontvesztéssel. Bacterial Adhesion and Corrosion (BAC): Ez a közös biológiai és fizikai tudományos kísérlet azt tanulmányozza, hogyan viselkednek különböző baktériumokból álló biofilmek mikrogravitációban. A biofilmek ellenállhatnak a hagyományos tisztításnak és szennyezhetik a vízrendszereket, veszélyeztetve az űrhajósok egészségét. A vizsgálat feltérképezi a biofilm növekedéséhez kapcsolódó géneket, teszteli, hogy ezek a biofilmek károsíthatják-e a rozsdamentes acélt, és értékeli, hogy mennyire hatékonyak az ezüstalapú fertőtlenítőszerek. article_content: QYOU Media has named Raj Mishra, a digital leader and strategist, as Group CEO of its India operations, effective immediately. Mishra will oversee all business units and aims to enhance operational and financial synergies as QYOU Media expands its focus on digital distribution and direct-to-consumer initiatives in India. Appointed to QYOU’s Board of Directors on May 30, 2023, Mishra brings over 13 years of experience in the mobile, media, and entertainment sectors. He has held senior management roles in building successful app businesses in India, specializing in go-to-market strategies, sales, marketing, business growth, and profit and loss management in the dynamic social media landscape. Notably, Mishra was the first employee of Musical.ly in India (now TikTok), where he played a key role in reaching over 60 million monthly active users. As Country Head for Musical.ly and later TikTok after its acquisition, he contributed to ByteDance’s growth in India by building local teams, establishing business partnerships, and fostering the creator community. Curt Marvis, CEO and co-founder of QYOU Media, commented, 'We are thrilled to have Raj on board to lead the next stage of our growth in India. His experience as a consultant to QYOU India in recent months showed us that his skills align perfectly with our goal to become a bigger brand focused on direct consumer engagement. This includes our recent launch of the new freemium version of Q GamesMela. Raj’s understanding of the creator economy, thanks to his roles at Musical.ly and TikTok, is invaluable as we build a creator-centric brand. His new role marks a very exciting chapter for QYOU in India.' Raj Mishra said, 'I joined QYOU Media's board because I saw great potential in what the company has already established. Since getting more involved, I believe the opportunities are even greater than I first realized. There is still much work to do, and we have only begun to explore the possibilities. I've shared my vision for growth with Curt and the Board, and I'm eager to collaborate with executive management and employees across business units to help QYOU reach the level of success we all believe is possible in India.' QYOU Media's business units in India include QYOU Media India, which operates broadcast and connected TV channels; Chtrbox Technologies, an influencer marketing platform; and Maxamtech Digital Ventures, which focuses on gaming. Other industry updates: A group representing India's top telcos has accused global tech companies like Microsoft and Amazon of bypassing legal telecom channels by using WhatsApp and similar platforms for enterprise messaging, potentially resulting in an annual revenue loss of about ₹3,000 crore for both the government and service providers. Meanwhile, the Indian government has asked Apple to join a probe into alleged state-sponsored hacking of iPhones belonging to prominent Indians. In aviation, the Directorate General of Civil Aviation told the Delhi High Court that Go First’s leased aircraft and engines can be preregistered and returned to lessors, further challenging the struggling airline's prospects.

Mishra minden üzletágat felügyel majd, és célja az operatív és pénzügyi szinergiák erősítése, miközben a QYOU Media Indiában fokozza a digitális terjesztést és a közvetlen fogyasztói kezdeményezéseket. Mishrát 2023. május 30-án nevezték ki a QYOU igazgatótanácsába. Több mint 13 éves tapasztalatot hoz a mobil, média és szórakoztatóipar területéről, számos sikeres alkalmazásüzlet kiépítését vezette Indiában, különösen a piaci bevezetési stratégiák, értékesítés, marketing, üzleti növekedés és eredményességi menedzsment terén az egyre dinamikusabb közösségi média világában. Mishra volt az első alkalmazott Indiában a Musical.ly-nél (ma már TikTok), és kulcsszerepet játszott abban, hogy a felhasználók száma meghaladta a havi 60 milliót. A Musical.ly majd a TikTok országos vezetőjeként hozzájárult a ByteDance indiai növekedéséhez, helyi csapatokat épített ki, üzleti partnerségeket alapított, és támogatta a tartalomgyártók közösségét. Curt Marvis, a QYOU Media vezérigazgatója és társalapítója elmondta: 'Nagyon örülünk, hogy Raj csatlakozott hozzánk, és vezetni fogja következő növekedési szakaszunkat Indiában. Az elmúlt hónapokban, amikor tanácsadóként dolgozott a QYOU India számára, világossá vált számunkra, hogy készségei tökéletesen illeszkednek ahhoz a célhoz, hogy nagyobb márka legyünk, amely közvetlenebbül szólítja meg a fogyasztókat. Ez magában foglalja az új, freemium Q GamesMela bevezetését is. Raj tapasztalata a tartalomgyártói gazdaság működésében – Musical.ly-nél és TikToknál szerzett tapasztalatai révén – felbecsülhetetlen értékű számunkra, amikor egy alkotóközpontú márkát építünk. Új szerepköre izgalmas fejezetet nyit a QYOU számára Indiában.' Raj Mishra így nyilatkozott: 'Azért csatlakoztam a QYOU Media igazgatótanácsához, mert nagy lehetőséget láttam abban, amit a vállalat már eddig is elért. Most, hogy még közvetlenebbül részt veszek a munkában, az esélyeket még nagyobbnak látom, mint korábban. Rengeteg munka, koordináció és megvalósítás áll előttünk, és még csak most kezdjük el felfedezni a lehetőségeket. Megosztottam Curt-tel és az Igazgatótanáccsal a növekedésről alkotott elképzeléseimet, és alig várom, hogy együtt dolgozhassak a menedzsmenttel és a munkatársakkal minden üzletágban, hogy a QYOU indiai üzletágát arra a siker szintre emeljük, amelyben mindannyian hiszünk.' A QYOU Media indiai üzletágai közé tartozik a QYOU Media India, amely műsorszóró és CTV csatornákat üzemeltet, a Chtrbox Technologies (influencer marketing platform), valamint a Maxamtech Digital Ventures, amely a játékpiacra koncentrál. További iparági hírek: India vezető távközlési vállalatait képviselő csoport azt állítja, hogy a Microsoft és az Amazon megkerülik a jogi távközlési előírásokat a WhatsApp és hasonló platformok használatával céges üzenetküldésre, ami évente körülbelül 3000 crore rupia veszteséget okozhat mind a kormánynak, mind a szolgáltatóknak. Eközben a kormány az Apple-t is bevonta az állítólagos állami támogatású iPhone-feltörési kísérletek kivizsgálásába, amelyek prominens indiaiakat érintettek. A légiközlekedésben a Polgári Repülési Főigazgatóság közölte a Delhii Legfelsőbb Bírósággal, hogy a Go First lízingelt repülőgépei és hajtóművei előregisztrálhatók és visszaadhatók a lízingbeadóknak, ami tovább nehezíti a bajba jutott légitársaság helyzetét.

article_content: To address rising violence in Garcia, a city in the Mexican state of Nuevo Leon, officials are rolling out a program to train residents in firearm handling and shooting. Mayor Jaime Rodriguez Calderon—known as 'El Bronco'—says the effort aims to help people defend themselves in a city often troubled by crime. Rodriguez said he was prompted by frequent reports of kidnappings and thefts. The new program, part of a broader safety plan, encourages citizens to take an active role in their own protection. The free course, open to permit holders and held at a city hunting club using .22-caliber guns, will also teach urban defense topics such as basic first aid. So far, 3,000 participants from various backgrounds—including engineers, teachers, homemakers, and retired military—have registered, though the start date remains undecided. The initiative comes as Nuevo Leon lawmakers discuss relaxing weapons laws. article_content: Arab leaders, alongside Iranian President Ebrahim Raisi, are convening in Riyadh for special summits focused on ending the Gaza war and preventing further regional escalation. These emergency meetings—organized by the Arab League and the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation (OIC)—follow Hamas's October 7 attacks, which Israeli officials say resulted in around 1,200 deaths and 239 hostages. Israel’s subsequent military operation has led to over 11,000 deaths, mostly civilians including many children, according to the Hamas-run health ministry. Aid organizations are warning of a dire humanitarian situation in Gaza, urging an immediate ceasefire as supplies dwindle. According to Arab League Assistant Secretary-General Hossam Zaki, the league wants to present a unified stance to stop hostilities, support Palestinians, and hold Israel responsible. However, the Palestinian militant group Islamic Jihad remains critical, with Deputy Secretary-General Mohammad al-Hindi expressing doubt about the summits’ effectiveness due to their delayed timing. Israel and the US have resisted ceasefire calls, which is expected to be a focal point of criticism at the summits. Saudi analyst Aziz Alghashian notes frustration is not only directed at Israel but also at its Western backers, especially the United States. Recent regional visits by US Secretary of State Antony Blinken and UK Foreign Secretary James Cleverly have reflected these tensions. Cleverly reiterated Israel’s right to self-defense, while recognizing the urgent humanitarian crisis in Gaza. President Raisi’s attendance at the OIC marks his first Saudi visit since the March diplomatic renewal, symbolizing tense but open channels between the two rivals. Iran’s support for Hamas, Hezbollah, and Yemen’s Huthi rebels makes it central to concerns about potential regional spillover; confirmed exchanges have already occurred between Israel and Hezbollah, and Huthi rebels claimed recent missile attacks into southern Israel. Saudi Arabia feels increasingly vulnerable due to its relationship with the US and its previous pursuit of closer ties with Israel. Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman recently condemned violations by Israeli forces, marking his first public comment on the conflict, though Riyadh has previously issued similar statements. Analyst Kim Ghattas suggests that both Saudi Arabia and Iran believe their diplomatic communication channels offer some protection amidst regional instability. Separately, India’s industrial growth dropped to 5.8% in September, down from 10.3% in August, due to a high base and adverse weather. Meanwhile, Ranjan Pai, chairman of Manipal Education & Medical Group, has invested Rs 1,400 crore (approximately $168 million) in Aakash Institute, a Byju’s subsidiary.

Ezeket a rendkívüli üléseket az Arab Liga és az Iszlám Együttműködési Szervezet (OIC) szervezi, a Hamász október 7-i támadásai nyomán, melyekről izraeli tisztviselők szerint mintegy 1.200 ember vesztette életét és 239-en lettek túszok. Segélyszervezetek súlyos humanitárius válságra figyelmeztetnek Gázában, és azonnali tűzszünetet sürgetnek, mivel az alapvető ellátmányok fogytán vannak. Az Arab Liga főtitkár-helyettese, Hossam Zaki szerint a szervezet egységes fellépést kíván mutatni a harcok befejezése, a palesztinok támogatása és Izrael felelősségre vonása érdekében. Ugyanakkor a palesztin Iszlám Dzsihád továbbra is szkeptikus: főtitkár-helyettese, Mohammad al-Hindi, kétségét fejezte ki a csúcstalálkozók eredményességét illetően azok késedelmes megtartása miatt. Izrael és az Egyesült Államok eddig nem támogatták a tűzszünetre vonatkozó felhívásokat, ami a csúcson várhatóan hangsúlyos kritikát vált ki. Aziz Alghashian szaúdi elemző szerint a frusztráció nemcsak Izrael, hanem legfőbb nyugati támogatói, főleg az Egyesült Államok irányába is megjelenik. Az amerikai külügyminiszter, Antony Blinken és a brit külügyminiszter, James Cleverly közelmúltbeli látogatásai szintén tükrözik ezeket a feszültségeket. Cleverly megerősítette Izrael önvédelmi jogát, ugyanakkor hangsúlyozta a gázai humanitárius helyzet súlyosságát. Raisi elnök részvétele az OIC találkozón első szaúdi látogatása a diplomáciai kapcsolatok márciusi helyreállítása óta, ami a két ország közötti feszült, de nyitott kommunikációt jelez. Irán támogatja a Hamászt, a Hezbollahot és a jemeni húszi lázadókat, ami központi kérdéssé teszi szerepét a konfliktus regionális kiterjedésének veszélye miatt; már történtek összecsapások Izrael és a Hezbollah között, a húszik pedig rakétatámadásokat jelentettek Izrael déli részére. Szaúd-Arábia különösen kiszolgáltatottnak érzi magát amerikai szövetsége és korábbi Izraelhez fűződő kapcsolati törekvései miatt. Mohamed bin Szalmán koronaherceg a közelmúltban elítélte az izraeli erők jogsértéseit, ami első nyilvános megszólalása a konfliktusban, bár Rijád korábban is adott ki hasonló nyilatkozatokat. Kim Ghattas elemző szerint Szaúd-Arábia és Irán is abban reménykedik, hogy a köztük zajló diplomáciai párbeszéd enyhíti a regionális feszültségeket. Más hírek: India ipari növekedése szeptemberben 5,8%-ra esett vissza az augusztusi 10,3%-ról, főként a bázishatás és az időjárás miatt. Emellett Ranjan Pai, a Manipal Education & Medical Group elnöke 1.400 crore rúpiát (kb. 168 millió dollárt) fektetett az Aakash Institute-ba, a Byju’s leányvállalatába.

article_content: An oil tanker bound for the United States was hijacked off the coast of Somalia with a crew of 28 onboard, maritime authorities reported. The M/V Maran Centaurus was seized about 600 nautical miles northeast of the Seychelles while traveling from Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, to New Orleans, Louisiana, according to the Maritime Security Center, which is managed by the European naval force. The crew comprises 16 Filipinos, nine Greeks, two Ukrainians, and one Romanian. The 300,000-ton tanker was captured on Sunday and later changed course toward Harardhere or Hobyo, along Somalia’s central-western coast. Somali pirates have turned maritime kidnappings into a lucrative business. This year, pirates have captured more than 50 ships off the Somali coast and are currently holding 12, including the fishing vessel Alakrana, according to Spanish Defense Minister Carme Chacon. Attacks in the area have risen significantly, says the International Maritime Bureau, which monitors shipping crimes. However, successful hijackings have declined due to the increased presence of international naval forces. The Bureau reported on October 21 that the first nine months of this year saw more pirate attacks than all of last year. From January 1 to September 30, pirates carried out 306 attacks worldwide, compared to 293 for all of 2008. More than half of these attacks involved suspected Somali pirates operating off the east coast of Somalia and in the Gulf of Aden, an important shipping lane between Yemen and Somalia.

Az M/V Maran Centaurus-t mintegy 600 tengeri mérföldre a Seychelle-szigetektől északkeletre foglalták el, miközben a szaúd-arábiai Dzsiddából tartott a louisianai New Orleansba – jelentette a Tengeri Biztonsági Központ, amelyet az európai haditengerészeti erők működtetnek. article_content:
Police are investigating the death of an 82-year-old man from Milton Keynes as a possible assisted suicide. The man's 75-year-old wife has been arrested and released on bail while officers consult the Crown Prosecution Service (CPS) on how to proceed. This approach by Thames Valley Police is unusual, as such deaths are typically investigated as murder or manslaughter.

The deceased, identified by neighbors as John Sampford, was a retired coach-painter who had reportedly been diagnosed with leukaemia and given only three months to live. His body was discovered after police were called to their home in Bancroft Park in the early hours of Friday. Post-mortem results indicate he died by strangulation. No other suspects are being sought.

The couple had been married for 50 years. Mr. Sampford's wife, Sheila, was released on bail until next month. Assisted suicide—defined as actively helping someone to take their own life—is illegal under the 1961 Suicide Act.

Conservative MP Mark Pritchard, vice-chairman of the Parliamentary Pro-Life Group, said: "If a crime has been committed, the police must investigate. It is not the police's job to write or interpret the law—that is for Parliament and the courts."

Nadine Dorries, another Conservative MP who has campaigned on pro-life issues, added: "This case should be treated as murder. The law states that assisted suicide is illegal."

In 2010, the Director of Public Prosecutions issued new guidelines on handling assisted suicide cases, following high-profile legal action by Debbie Purdy. The guidelines clarify that assisting someone to end their own life may be treated differently from actively ending a person's life, which constitutes murder or manslaughter.

The CPS stated: "We have had contact with Thames Valley Police, but we have not yet received the case file."

Holttestét péntek hajnalban találták meg, miután a rendőrséget kihívták bancroft park-i otthonukba. A boncolás szerint halálát fojtogatás okozta. Más gyanúsítottat nem keresnek.

A házaspár ötven éve volt házas. Mr. Sampford felesége, Sheila, óvadék ellenében jövő hónapig szabadlábon maradhat. A segített öngyilkosság – vagyis ha valaki aktívan segít másnak véget vetni az életének – az 1961-es öngyilkossági törvény alapján illegális.

Nadine Dorries, szintén konzervatív képviselő, aki pro-life ügyekben aktív, hozzátette: „Ezt az esetet gyilkosságként kell kezelni. A törvény szerint a segített öngyilkosság illegális.”

A Koronaügyészség azt közölte: „Kapcsolatban állunk a Thames Valley rendőrséggel, de az ügy aktáját még nem kaptuk meg.”

article_content: Communities of Indian origin living in New Jersey and New York came together at local waterfronts to celebrate the traditional Chhath festival over the weekend. The festivities started on Saturday and continued Sunday, with Papaianni Park in Edison, NJ, as a key gathering spot. The park was adorned with floral decorations, and women dressed in customary attire performed rituals, making offerings to the sun god during both sunset and sunrise. Fasting participants broke their fast on Monday morning after a sunrise prayer. In Kathmandu, similar ceremonies took place, with devotees assembling at sacred water bodies Sunday evening, presenting 'Arghya' to the sun and preparing for a night of worship and fasting. Chhath is observed to pray for the health, longevity, and happiness of family members, as well as for the fulfillment of personal hopes.

Az ünnepségek szombaton kezdődtek és vasárnap folytatódtak, kiemelt helyszínként az edisoni Papaianni Parkban. article_content: Following the debut of ChatGPT, many schools and colleges quickly banned its use to prevent students from turning in essays created by artificial intelligence. This left teachers grappling with the issue of detecting AI-driven plagiarism. Now, the approach is evolving, with several institutions beginning to permit generative AI as a supportive tool, provided it's not used dishonestly. However, what counts as acceptable use—especially in college admissions and application essays—remains vague and inconsistent. Adam Nguyen, who leads the tutoring company Ivy Link, notes that colleges, particularly elite ones, haven't agreed on any standard rules about using tools like GPT for applications. In a test earlier this year, admissions experts found that AI-produced essays could pass as real student work in many cases, but probably wouldn't succeed at highly selective universities. Nguyen points out that fully AI-written essays often have telling signs, such as repeated phrases and generally unremarkable writing. He warns that obvious AI use could harm a student's chances. There's still a gray area when it comes to getting help from AI for drafting or revising essays. Nguyen suggests that while students can use AI to brainstorm or start structuring their essays, it's vital they rewrite and personalize most of the content—about 80%—to ensure their work is authentic. If the end result is distinctly the student's own voice, most colleges probably won't mind, as long as the AI's involvement isn't clear.
translated_content: A ChatGPT megjelenése után sok iskola és egyetem gyorsan betiltotta a használatát, hogy elkerülje az AI által írt esszék leadását. Ez kihívást jelentett a tanárok számára is, akiknek újfajta plágiumot kellett felismerniük. Mostanra azonban több intézmény is engedélyezi a generatív mesterséges intelligencia használatát támogatás céljából, amennyiben azt nem csalásra használják. Az azonban továbbra sem tisztázott, pontosan mi számít elfogadhatónak, különösen a jelentkezési folyamatban és az esszéírásban. Adam Nguyen, az Ivy Link tanácsadó cég vezetője kiemeli, hogy az egyetemek – főleg az elit intézmények – nem dolgoztak ki egységes szabályokat az olyan eszközök, mint a GPT jelentkezési anyagokban történő használatáról. Egy idei teszt során felvételi tanácsadók úgy ítélték meg, hogy az AI-írt esszék legtöbbször valódi diákmunka benyomását keltik, de a legelitebb egyetemeken kevésbé lennének sikeresek. Nguyen szerint az AI által teljesen írt szövegek gyakran ismétlődnek és középszerűek. Felhívja a figyelmet, hogy ezek felismerése ronthatja a diák esélyeit. Az, hogy mennyire lehet AI-t igénybe venni szerkesztés vagy ötletelés céljából, még mindig képlékeny. Nguyen javaslata szerint az AI-t inkább az esszé elindításához vagy ötletekhez érdemes használni – de a tartalom legalább 80%-át át kell írni és sajátossá tenni. Ha az esszé tükrözi a diák saját gondolatait, a legtöbb egyetem valószínűleg nem tiltakozik, feltéve, hogy az AI-használat nem szembetűnő.

article_content: Former Radio 1 DJ Dave Lee Travis was arrested by police investigating allegations of sexual abuse following the Jimmy Savile scandal. The 67-year-old was detained during a morning raid at his £1 million home in rural Buckinghamshire, accused of sexual assault dating back to the late 1960s. The arrest coincided with Scotland Yard announcing that the number of potential victims of historic abuse linked to Savile had increased to 450. Travis was released on bail after questioning at Aylesbury police station. He became the fourth person arrested as part of the widespread investigation initiated after Savile was revealed to be a predatory offender. Other men arrested and on bail include former BBC producer Wilfred De’Ath, pop star Gary Glitter, and comedian Freddie Starr. The case of Savile’s former driver Ray Teret, questioned about child sex offenses, is being handled separately. Police arrived at Travis's home in Mentmore at 7:45 am. Travis was questioned for over five hours before returning home in the evening. His solicitor said he would not be making a statement. Several allegations have been made that Travis, who currently hosts a weekend show at Magic AM, inappropriately touched female colleagues during the 1970s and 1980s. Broadcaster Vivien Creegor claimed that he touched her inappropriately while live on Radio 4 in the 1980s. An unnamed woman has also alleged that Travis put his hand up her skirt in 1977, when she was 17. Police spent over six hours searching his home. Travis’s wife Marianne was visibly shocked, according to a neighbor who offered her support. Travis has strongly denied all allegations, stating that the standards in the entertainment industry were different during the 1970s. The NSPCC has received numerous calls relating to Savile, and reports of other abuse cases have tripled in the past month. A Metropolitan Police spokesperson confirmed that the allegations against Travis are not directly linked to Savile. Dave Lee Travis, born David Patrick Griffin in Buxton, Derbyshire, started his career as a designer before moving into full-time DJ work. He became popular as host of BBC Radio 1's breakfast show from 1978 to 1980 and was later known for presenting BBC World Service’s ‘A Jolly Good Show’. Burmese pro-democracy leader Aung San Suu Kyi has stated that Travis’s radio program was significant support for her during captivity. Magic AM declined to comment pending the outcome of the investigation. The BBC removed a 1977 episode of Top Of The Pops featuring Travis from its scheduled programming.

A letartóztatás egybeesett azzal, hogy a Scotland Yard bejelentette: a Savile-hez köthető történelmi visszaélések potenciális áldozatainak száma 450-re nőtt. A burmai ellenzéki vezető, Aung San Suu Kyi szerint Travis rádióműsora jelentős lelki támaszt nyújtott neki fogsága alatt. A Magic AM csak a nyomozás lezárása után kíván nyilatkozni. Britain's independent food shops are experiencing a revival thanks to the ongoing 'foodie' trend. Once struggling, stores like bakers have risen by 31% year-on-year, while fishmongers increased 28% as vacant high street spaces fill up. Experts partly attribute a 27% surge in independent food retailers to shifting consumer trust following the horse meat scandal and criticism of major supermarkets. Shoppers are now more willing to pay higher prices for quality and transparency, helping butchers grow by 9%.

Data from Simply Business, which assessed over 40,000 retail outlets between 2012 and 2013, shows a 65% increase in independent supermarkets and a 32% rise in general food shops. Smaller specialty retailers also benefited: delicatessens grew by 25%, greengrocers by 24%, and wine merchants rose 10%. Local and national government schemes, such as relaxed parking restrictions and lower business rates, have further supported this expansion.

The overall effect has been a drop in empty high street shops to the lowest level in three years, according to insurance group Simply Business. Their CEO Jason Stockwood commented, 'The growth of independent food merchants highlights how quickly small businesses can respond to popular trends. We’re hopeful these local shops will keep drawing shoppers away from the big chains, bringing renewed energy to community high streets. Independent businesses are essential for the continued growth of the UK economy, and our findings reinforce their value.'

article_content: Jessica Ennis-Hill has resumed training and is already looking forward to defending her Olympic heptathlon title in Rio de Janeiro in 2016, after spending nearly a year away from competition. Ennis-Hill gave birth to her son Reggie in July, and announced on Tuesday that her preparations for the Rio Olympics are now underway. ‘Back in the gym… building back into training,’ Ennis-Hill posted on Instagram alongside a photo of herself, adding, ‘Exciting and slightly scary! My journey to Rio starts now.’ Ennis-Hill previously claimed the heptathlon gold at London 2012, setting a British and Commonwealth record with a score of 6,955 points — her victory in the 800m being one of the Games’ memorable highlights. The 28-year-old chose to prioritize starting her family instead of pursuing a near-certain Commonwealth Games gold. She was also forced to miss the 2013 World Championships due to an Achilles tendon injury, and in January decided to focus on her personal life over competing in the European Championships and Commonwealth Games.

Az utam Rio felé most kezdődik.” Ennis-Hill korábban a 2012-es londoni olimpián szerzett aranyérmet hétpróbában, brit és Nemzetközösségi rekordot elérve 6 955 ponttal — 800 méteren aratott győzelme az egyik legemlékezetesebb momentum volt a játékokon. article_content: Alex Furmansky, inspired by his younger sister Michelle’s colorful refrigerator artwork, founded Budsies—a company based in Boynton Beach, Florida, that transforms children’s drawings into custom stuffed animals. Customers can send photos of their drawings, doodles, or even pictures of real people to Budsies via email or text. A team of artists, designers, cutters, and seamstresses then creates each unique toy by hand using new, hypoallergenic materials that comply with strict safety and stitching standards. Each plush toy is about 16 inches tall, costs $69, and takes around five weeks to make. Budsies has created toys for a diverse range of customers, including children in therapy and adults who want their own designs recreated. Every toy undergoes careful inspection to ensure it closely matches the original artwork and meets quality standards before being shipped with a framed copy of the drawing that inspired it. Furmansky highlights Budsies' mission: bringing imagination to life by creating lasting, one-of-a-kind companions.

Az ügyfelek elküldhetik rajzaikat, firkáikat vagy akár fényképeiket e-mailben vagy üzenetben a Budsies-nek. Egy művészekből, tervezőkből, szabókból és varrónőkből álló csapat kézzel készíti el az egyedi játékokat, új, hipoallergén anyagokat használva, miközben szigorú biztonsági és varrási előírásoknak felelnek meg. Az elkészült plüssfigurák körülbelül 40 centiméter magasak, áruk 69 dollár, és az elkészítésük nagyjából öt hetet vesz igénybe. article_content: In 2024, companies working with payments will need to focus on creating valuable customer experiences rather than simply processing transactions. As digital payments have become an everyday occurrence—especially since the pandemic—the industry’s attention is shifting. It’s no longer enough to just offer quick or accessible payments. Organizations must find innovative ways to add value at every stage of the payment process. This can involve connecting payments to services like identity verification, ticket purchases, or loyalty rewards, particularly in integrated digital wallets. For B2B payment providers, utilizing their own networks to provide greater benefits to their business clients will be key. The goal is to move away from treating payments as just another commodity, instead using them to unlock new and enriched experiences for users. Those who succeed will be the ones who surround payments with useful features and impactful services. Payment industry leaders will need to treat payments as a strategic priority, whether that means embedding payments as a core part of business operations or rolling out advanced real-time capabilities that deliver clear advantages for customers. article_content: Taiwan’s Foxconn, the world’s largest contract electronics manufacturer and a key supplier to Apple, reaffirmed its expectation for strong year-end holiday sales on Sunday. The company reported that customer demand remains robust in both China and the United States. The fourth quarter is traditionally a busy period for Taiwanese technology firms, as companies like Foxconn accelerate production of smartphones, tablets, and other electronics to fulfill orders for major global vendors—especially ahead of the holidays in Western markets. In a statement, Foxconn noted that the second half of the year is a ‘traditional peak season’ for consumer technology products, and operations will ramp up sequentially. The company reiterated its previous forecast of significant fourth-quarter growth compared to the third quarter, without providing further details. Foxconn, officially known as Hon Hai Precision Industry Co Ltd, also reported that its October revenue reached T$741.2 billion (US$23.09 billion). This is its second-highest October revenue on record, though it represents a 4.56% decrease year-on-year, and a 12.2% increase from September. Revenue from smart consumer electronics—such as smartphones—saw significant month-on-month growth, driven by new product launches and anticipation of shopping events like China’s Singles Day and the US Thanksgiving holidays. The company remains Apple’s largest iPhone assembler. Apple launched a new series of iPhones in September, but recently issued a holiday quarter sales forecast that fell short of Wall Street expectations, pressured by weaker demand for iPads and wearable devices. Foxconn will release its third-quarter earnings on November 14, providing further details on its outlook. Foxconn’s Taipei-listed shares closed down 1.2% on Friday prior to its October sales announcement, compared to a 0.7% rise for the broader market. The stock has declined 4% so far this year, giving the company a market value of $41.5 billion. (USD 1 = TWD 32.0980)

A Foxconn közleményében hangsúlyozta, hogy az év második fele a fogyasztói technológiai termékek 'hagyományos csúcsszezonja', és a működés fokozatosan fel fog pörögni. A cég megismételte korábbi prognózisát, miszerint a negyedik negyedévben jelentős növekedés várható a harmadik negyedévhez képest, de további részleteket nem közölt. A Foxconn, hivatalos nevén Hon Hai Precision Industry Co Ltd, azt is közölte, hogy októberi bevétele elérte a 741,2 milliárd tajvani dollárt (23,09 milliárd amerikai dollár). Az okoseszközökből – például okostelefonokból – származó bevételek jelentős havi növekedést mutattak, amit az új termékek megjelenése és az olyan események iránti várakozás fűtött, mint Kína Szinglik napja vagy az Egyesült Államok hálaadása. A Foxconn november 14-én teszi közzé harmadik negyedéves pénzügyi jelentését, amelyben további részleteket árul el várakozásairól. A Foxconn részvényeinek ára 1,2%-kal csökkent pénteken, az októberi forgalmi adatok bejelentése előtt, míg a szélesebb piac 0,7%-ot emelkedett. A 14-year-old Singapore Sports School student, Pranav Madhaik, passed away after feeling unwell following a 400m fitness time trial. According to the Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF), Pranav was taken to the National University Hospital (NUH) on October 5 in accordance with medical protocol. NUH was selected because it is equipped with paediatric emergency medical facilities and was the fastest option at the time. Khoo Teck Puat Hospital, although closer to the school in Woodlands, does not have such facilities.

SCDF received a call for assistance at around 6:50pm. Upon arrival at 7pm, paramedics found Pranav, a Secondary 2 badminton academy student, lying on the running track. He was conscious and able to converse normally. Pranav's vital signs, including heart rate and blood oxygen level, were stable as he was carried into the ambulance. However, his blood pressure was low and he was breathless, so the crew administered oxygen and guided his breathing, also raising his legs to improve circulation. By about 7:20pm, his blood pressure improved.

Following Ministry of Health and SCDF protocols for stable patients under 16, Pranav was conveyed to NUH. Although KK Women’s and Children’s Hospital also has paediatric emergency facilities, reaching NUH was faster at that moment. On the way, Pranav became drowsy, prompting the paramedic to alert NUH, which prepared to receive him. The ambulance arrived around 7:35pm, and Pranav was handed over to the emergency team on standby. Sadly, Pranav died six days later, on October 11.

Az NUH-t azért választották, mert rendelkezik gyermek sürgősségi ellátással, és az adott időpontban ez volt a leggyorsabb lehetőség. A SCDF körülbelül 18:50-kor kapott segélyhívást. Miután a mentősök 19 órakor megérkeztek, a második évfolyamos, tollaslabda-akadémiára járó Pranavot a futópályán fekve találták meg. Dick Advocaat has stepped down as Serbia's national football coach following a 3-1 home defeat to Denmark in a Euro 2016 qualifier on Friday night. The Serbian Football Association (FSS) confirmed Advocaat's departure on Saturday. The Dutch manager was appointed in July on a two-year contract but leaves after only four months in charge.

During his brief tenure, Advocaat failed to lead Serbia to a victory in four matches, with the team drawing against France and Armenia. Serbia's hopes of qualifying remain uncertain, as they have just one point from two games. Their standings are further complicated by UEFA’s pending verdict on last month's abandoned qualifier against Albania, which was called off due to crowd trouble.

The match against Denmark, played in an empty stadium, saw Nicklas Bendtner score for the visitors in their 3-1 victory. Serbian defender Branislav Ivanovic competed for the ball against Denmark's Christian Eriksen during the match. Prior to his time with Serbia, the 67-year-old Advocaat managed the national teams of Russia and the Netherlands, and spent four seasons at Rangers between 1998 and 2002.

article_content: Britain’s smallest man, actor Michael Henbury, became the target of a playful family prank during his Ice Bucket Challenge. The 2ft 11in performer, best known for his roles as a goblin in 'Harry Potter' and an Ewok in 'Return of the Jedi', took part in the challenge to support his friend Kevin Lamb from Southampton, who is undergoing treatment for myeloma cancer. Henbury, nominated by a colleague at the UK Border Force, said that only a small bucket of water was supposed to be used because of his size. In the video, his 10-year-old nephew, Simon Leah, pours the first, smaller bucket of water on him. Henbury jokes afterwards, saying, 'Nothing to it really,' and adds, 'I don't know what all the fuss was about; it was quite easy.' However, to the delight of his family, his 13-year-old son, Joseph, suddenly tips a much larger bucket of iced water over his head. The family laughs as Henbury reacts with a grimace as the cold water pours down. Despite being caught off guard, the 53-year-old actor remained in good spirits and laughed off the prank. He quipped, 'I nearly drowned there. I may have to go to A&E now. There's bits of me that have frozen.'

Henburyt a UK Border Force egyik kollégája nevezte meg, és elmondása szerint mérete miatt csak egy kis vödör vizet szabadott volna használni. A videón 10 éves unokaöccse, Simon Leah önti rá az első, kisebb vödör vizet. Henbury viccelődve mondja utána: 'Semmiség az egész,' és hozzáteszi: 'Nem értem, mi ebben a nagy ügy; egész könnyű volt.' Van, ami biztosan lefagyott.'

The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) have issued a warning to consumers to avoid eating certain whole and cut cantaloupes and pre-cut fruit products due to a salmonella outbreak. At least 43 people in 15 states have fallen ill, and 17 have been hospitalized, according to the FDA. The most recent reported illness began on November 6.

Three brands—Malchita, Aldi, and Vinyard—have recalled various fresh cantaloupe and pineapple products sold in at least 13 states and in Canada. The FDA reports that out of 29 people who became ill, 15 had consumed cantaloupe.

The recalled fruit was sold at stores in Arizona, California, Maryland, New Jersey, Tennessee, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Michigan, Oklahoma, Wisconsin, Texas, Florida, and Canada. However, distribution networks mean these products may have reached consumers in other areas as well.

Salmonella infection typically causes diarrhea, fever, and abdominal cramps, with symptoms developing six hours to six days after consuming contaminated food. Most people recover within four to seven days. However, children under five and seniors are at higher risk of severe, and sometimes fatal, illness.

Az FDA szerint eddig legalább 43 ember betegedett meg 15 államban, közülük 17-en kórházi kezelésre szorultak. Az utolsó megbetegedést november 6-án jelentették.

Három márka – Malchita, Aldi és Vinyard – friss sárgadinnye és ananász termékeit hívták vissza legalább 13 amerikai államban és Kanadában. Az FDA jelentése alapján 29 megbetegedett közül 15-nél igazolták a sárgadinnye fogyasztását.

A visszahívott gyümölcsöt árusították például Arizonában, Kaliforniában, Marylandben, New Jerseyben, Tennessee-ben, Illinoisban, Indianában, Kentuckyban, Michiganben, Oklahomában, Wisconsinban, Texasban, Floridában és Kanadában. Az elosztási láncok miatt azonban más helyeken is megjelenhetett ez az áru.

A szalmonella-fertőzés általában hasmenéssel, lázzal és hasi görcsökkel jár, amelyek 6 órával – 6 nappal a fertőzött élelmiszer elfogyasztása után jelentkezhetnek. A legtöbb beteg 4–7 nap alatt felépül, de az 5 év alatti gyerekek és az idősek nagyobb veszélyben vannak, náluk akár súlyos, életveszélyes szövődmények is előfordulhatnak.

article_content: John Durkin, a 21-year-old economics student from Rye Beach, New Hampshire, was discovered dead in a railway tunnel in central Rome, Italian authorities confirmed. Durkin had been attending Bates College in Maine and was spending the semester in Rome through a program organized by Trinity College. He was last seen leaving a bar alone after an outing with friends two days prior to his body being found. Investigators in Italy are examining the circumstances leading to his death, and officials from both Bates and Trinity College are collaborating with the local police. Durkin’s family issued a statement expressing gratitude for the public’s support during the search and shared their heartbreak over his loss. His father, Tim Durkin, had traveled to Rome after John went missing. Bates College President Clayton Spencer and the U.S. Embassy in Rome both offered condolences to the Durkin family, acknowledging the deep impact of the loss. Margaret Mauer-Fazio, a Bates economics professor, praised Durkin’s academic abilities, recalling his insightful work in her class, while his football coach, Mark Harriman, described Durkin as a source of inspiration and leadership for his team. Authorities continue to investigate the case to determine how Durkin died.

article_content: Sandy Jenkins, who served as the controller at Collin Street Bakery in Corsicana, Texas, is accused of stealing $16 million over eight years. Prosecutors allege Jenkins and his wife, Kay, used the misappropriated funds to finance an opulent lifestyle, acquiring luxury properties, high-end vehicles, designer goods, and private jet trips. Though Jenkins' annual salary was $50,000, records indicate the couple spent as much as $250,000 each month. Authorities claim that Jenkins manipulated 888 company checks to conceal the embezzlement, which went unnoticed due to insufficient financial scrutiny. The alleged theft occurred between December 2004 and August 2012. Both Jenkins and Kay face multiple charges, including mail fraud, money laundering, and making false statements, following an FBI investigation. The authorities have seized several assets: a mansion in Corsicana, a villa in Santa Fe, luxury vehicles, jewelry, artworks, furs, and a Steinway piano. During the fraud, the Jenkinses reportedly charged $11 million to their American Express cards and made extravagant purchases such as exclusive jewelry, numerous watches, designer handbags, wine collections, and collectibles. The discrepancy between the couple's expenditures and Jenkins’ modest salary went undetected for years, partly due to a culture of trust and the absence of regular audits at the bakery. Jenkins allegedly manipulated the bakery's financial records and used falsified invoices to hide the missing funds. Hayden Crawford, a partner at the bakery, acknowledged management never imagined an employee could be responsible. The embezzlement only came to light when an accounts department newcomer, Semetric Williams, identified financial irregularities and reported them. After being confronted, Jenkins was dismissed and subsequently tried to hide valuables and cash, some of which authorities later recovered. If convicted, Jenkins could face up to 200 years in prison. Both he and his wife may have to forfeit assets and repay Collin Street Bakery. This case has emphasized the importance of oversight in the longstanding, family-run bakery, renowned for its fruit cakes.

Bár Jenkins éves fizetése csak 50 000 dollár volt, a feljegyzések szerint a házaspár havonta akár 250 000 dollárt is költött. article_content: Globovision, a private Venezuelan television station known for its criticism of President Hugo Chavez, announced on Friday it will pay a significant fine after the country’s Supreme Court ordered the seizure of its assets. On Thursday evening, the court ruled that Globovision’s property and equipment would be confiscated due to the station's failure to pay a $2.2 million fine issued last year. Currently, Globovision is contesting the fine in court and has accused the Supreme Court of interfering with the appeals process. The broadcaster also questioned why the court ordered seizures valued at $5.7 million, which is more than double the original fine. Globovision described the court’s decision as 'grotesque and despotic,' noting that it compels the station to pay immediately before lower courts have ruled on the fine’s validity. According to the court, the higher seizure amount represents twice the original fine plus recovery costs. Globovision is Venezuela’s last major television channel openly critical of President Chavez. The asset seizure order comes just days before the official start of the electoral campaign. The original fine stems from the station’s coverage of a violent standoff at Rodeo II prison in June and July. Authorities claimed Globovision violated media laws by inciting public anxiety and political intolerance. These laws, passed in December, aim to promote 'social responsibility' in those providing TV, radio, and internet services, and apply to all forms of content distributed in Venezuela. Globovision defended its coverage of the prison riot—which left at least 22 dead and involved a nearly month-long standoff—arguing the penalties are politically motivated. The station warned that not paying the fine immediately could risk its closure. In a statement, Globovision reaffirmed its commitment to continue broadcasting independent news and criticism. Diosdado Cabello, a prominent Chavez supporter and president of the National Assembly, stated on Twitter that Globovision 'still believes it is above the law and the time to pay arrived today.' The government has previously investigated the broadcaster for its reporting and alleged failure to pay $2.3 million in taxes. In 2010, the state acquired a 25.8% interest in Globovision through the takeover of two companies holding shares in the station. Station officials maintain that these charges are politically motivated.

A bíróság csütörtök este döntött az ingatlanok és felszerelések elkobzásáról, mivel a csatorna nem fizette ki a tavaly kiszabott 2,2 millió dolláros bírságot. A Globovisión jelenleg fellebbez a bírság ellen, és azzal vádolja a legfelsőbb bíróságot, hogy beavatkozik a jogi eljárásba. A csatorna azt is kifogásolja, hogy a bíróság miért rendelt el 5,7 millió dollár értékű lefoglalást, ami több, mint kétszerese az eredeti bírságnak. A Globovisión a döntést „groteszknek és despotikusnak” minősítette, kiemelve, hogy az a bírság azonnali kifizetését írja elő, mielőtt az alsóbb bíróságok döntést hoznának az ügyben. A bíróság szerint a nagyobb összeg az eredeti bírság kétszeresének és a végrehajtás költségeinek felel meg. A Globovisión Venezuela utolsó jelentős tévécsatornája, amely nyíltan kritizálja Chávez elnököt. Az eszközlefoglalás néhány nappal a hivatalos választási kampány kezdete előtt történt. Az eredeti bírság a Rodeo II börtönben történt erőszakos összetűzésről szóló tudósításból ered, ami júniusban és júliusban zajlott. A hatóságok szerint a Globovisión megsértette a médiatörvényt azzal, hogy közszorongást és politikai intoleranciát szított. Ez a decemberben elfogadott törvény célja, hogy „társadalmi felelősséget” szabjon minden tévé-, rádió- és internetszolgáltató számára, minden Venezuelában továbbított tartalomra vonatkozóan. A Globovisión megvédte a börtönlázadásról – amely legalább 22 halálos áldozattal járt, és csaknem egy hónapig tartott – szóló tudósítását, és azt állítja, hogy a büntetések politikai indíttatásúak. A csatorna szerint az azonnali fizetés elmaradása akár bezárásukhoz is vezethet. Nyilatkozatában megerősítették elkötelezettségüket a független tájékoztatás és kritika folytatása iránt. Diosdado Cabello, Chávez híve és a nemzetgyűlés elnöke, Twitteren közölte: a Globovisión „még mindig azt hiszi, hogy a törvény felett áll, de ma eljött a fizetés ideje”. A kormány korábban is vizsgálta a csatorna működését, valamint azt, hogy állítólag 2,3 millió dollár adót nem fizetett be. 2010-ben az állam két vállalat átvételével 25,8%-os részesedést szerzett a Globovisiónban. A csatorna illetékesei szerint ezek a vádak továbbra is politikai indíttatásúak.

Singapore’s Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong has announced plans to hand over power to Deputy Prime Minister Lawrence Wong ahead of the 2025 general election. This leadership transition is expected to occur as early as November 2024, aligning with the 70th anniversary of the People’s Action Party (PAP), which has governed Singapore for over 60 years.

Lee highlighted Wong’s effective leadership during the COVID-19 pandemic, noting his role in guiding Singapore’s response as head of the government task force. Lee expressed confidence in Wong’s abilities and said he would continue to support the new leader after stepping down, particularly during the next general election.

Wong, who previously served as finance and national development minister, is positioned to become Singapore’s fourth prime minister. Only one other leader outside the Lee family, Goh Chok Tong, has held this position since independence. The PAP has maintained significant control in Singapore’s political landscape, in part due to strict regulations on political activity and redistricting practices. Despite increased opposition success in the 2020 election, the PAP remained dominant, securing 83 out of 93 parliamentary seats.

The announcement follows a period of unusual political turmoil earlier in the year, when three senior PAP members resigned over corruption and personal scandals.

A vezetőváltás várhatóan már 2024 novemberében, a 70 éves fennállását ünneplő Népi Akció Párt (PAP) évfordulóján történhet meg, amely több mint hat évtizede vezeti az országot.

Lee hangsúlyozta Wong hatékony vezetői munkáját a COVID-19 járvány idején, amikor Wong a kormányzati munkacsoport élén irányította Szingapúr védekezését. Teljes bizalmáról biztosította Wongot, és kijelentette, hogy lemondását követően is mindenben támogatni fogja az új miniszterelnököt, különös tekintettel a következő parlamenti választásokra.

Wong, aki korábban pénzügyminiszter és nemzeti fejlesztési miniszter volt, minden bizonnyal Szingapúr negyedik miniszterelnöke lesz. A PAP meghatározó szerepet játszik Szingapúr politikájában, részben a politikai tevékenység szigorú szabályozásának és a választókerületek átalakításának köszönhetően. article_content: Taylor Swift’s concert film, 'The Eras Tour', remained at the top of the box office for a second weekend, earning $31 million from 3,855 locations, AMC Theaters reported. This comes after a record-breaking $92.8 million opening, making it the highest-grossing concert movie ever in North America within just a few days. Advance ticket sales and a restricted screening schedule (Thursdays to Sundays) led to a sharp 67% drop in its second weekend, as most fans saw it during its initial release. In contrast, Martin Scorsese’s 'Killers of the Flower Moon' marked Apple Studios’ major cinema debut, opening with $23 million across 3,628 U.S. theaters. The film, based on real events involving Osage Nation murders in the 1920s, stars Leonardo DiCaprio, Lily Gladstone, and Robert De Niro. The movie’s 206-minute runtime did not deter audiences—44% were under 30—and it received an A- CinemaScore along with critical praise and award potential. Internationally, it added $21 million. The collaboration between Apple and Paramount, with theaters as partners, reflects changing approaches to movie distribution. Apple plans to invest $1 billion annually in theatrical-first releases. Paramount initially planned to produce and distribute 'Killers', but later joined forces with Apple as production costs rose during the pandemic. Other weekend leaders were 'The Exorcist: Believer' ($5.6 million), 'PAW Patrol: The Mighty Movie' ($4.5 million), and a reissued 'The Nightmare Before Christmas' ($4.1 million) 30 years after its first release. These results illustrate how boundaries between the music, streaming, and cinema industries are shifting with evolving release strategies. Top films in U.S. and Canadian theaters this weekend (Comscore estimates): 1. 'Taylor Swift: The Eras Tour' – $31 million 2. 'Killers of the Flower Moon' – $23 million 3. 'The Exorcist: Believer' – $5.6 million 4. 'PAW Patrol: The Mighty Movie' – $4.5 million 5. 'The Nightmare Before Christmas' – $4.1 million 6. 'Saw X' – $3.6 million 7. 'The Creator' – $2.6 million 8. 'Leo: Bloody Sweet' – $2.1 million 9. 'A Haunting in Venice' – $1.1 million 10. 'The Blind' – $1 million Note: Weekend grosses for 'The Exorcist: Believer' and 'PAW Patrol: The Mighty Movie' were updated.

WWE’s Crown Jewel 2023 event in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, is set to continue the company’s recent streak of successful international shows. The event, headlined by Roman Reigns defending the Undisputed Universal Championship against LA Knight, sold out quickly, necessitating the addition of extra seating due to high demand. Top stars like Logan Paul, John Cena, Seth Rollins, and Cody Rhodes are scheduled for major singles matches, making Crown Jewel a pivotal show to sustain WWE’s momentum ahead of Survivor Series.

Projected key storylines and booking outcomes include:

1. Cody Rhodes vs. Damian Priest: Cody Rhodes, considered a likely contender for a WrestleMania 40 main event against Roman Reigns, faces Damian Priest as their Judgment Day rivalry continues. Rhodes is expected to secure a decisive win, ending his feud with Priest and maintaining his momentum. Priest, holding the Money in the Bank contract, may use this opportunity to attempt a cash-in later in the night.

2. Seth Rollins vs. Drew McIntyre: Drew McIntyre’s hinted heel turn could come to fruition after a loss to Seth Rollins in their World Heavyweight title match. Attacking Rollins post-match would refresh McIntyre’s character and set up a renewed feud. This situation may also provide an opening for Priest to cash in the Money in the Bank briefcase, with Rollins positioned as the heroic challenger against both McIntyre and Priest.

3. John Cena vs. Solo Sikoa: John Cena seeks his first singles win since April 2018, aiming to defeat Solo Sikoa at Crown Jewel. A victory would reinforce Cena’s status and preserve the significance of his future appearances. Sikoa is expected to recover from any loss, but a clean win for Cena is viewed as essential.

4. Logan Paul vs. Rey Mysterio: Logan Paul has established himself as a formidable heel and talented performer. Facing Rey Mysterio for the United States Championship, Paul’s potential victory would draw attention to WWE through his influential online presence and reward his growth as an entertainer.

5. Roman Reigns vs. LA Knight: LA Knight, while unlikely to defeat Roman Reigns amid Reigns’ projected path to a WrestleMania rematch with Cody Rhodes, should nonetheless remain strong in defeat. Interference or an unconventional finish is expected to protect Knight’s momentum and keep him positioned as a top star.

In summary, Crown Jewel 2023 is poised to be a key event for WWE, shaping major storylines and driving business success heading into the coming months.

WikiLeaks founder Julian Assange has been living in London’s Ecuadorean embassy for over a year, avoiding extradition to Sweden. Even in isolation, he’s found creative ways to show support for his newly formed WikiLeaks Party ahead of the Australian federal election.

Assange recently starred in a quirky music video produced with Australian satire group Juice Rap News. The clip blends rap and 80s-style rock, with Assange dressed as an exaggerated Aussie rocker—sporting a national flag headband and using classic Aussie slang—delivering a political message through a parody of John Farnham’s ‘You’re the Voice.’ The lyrics focus on calls for government transparency and poke fun at surveillance and political rhetoric. The segment was filmed inside the embassy.

The video lampoons prominent Australian politicians, including Kevin Rudd, Tony Abbott, and Julia Gillard, contrasting the mainstream candidates with Assange’s campaign. There’s even a nod to pop culture, likening the election to ‘Game of Thrones.’

The release coincides with recent news around WikiLeaks, notably Chelsea Manning’s (formerly Bradley Manning) 35-year sentence for leaking U.S. documents. Assange remains wanted in Sweden over 2010 sexual assault allegations and cannot leave the embassy without arrest. Although he’s running for the Senate representing Victoria on September 7th, his legal situation would likely prevent him from taking office. The WikiLeaks Party is running six candidates nationwide.

Assange nemrég egy szokatlan zenei videóban szerepelt az ausztrál szatirikus Juice Rap News csapatával. A videóban a rap és a 80-as évek rockzenéje keveredik, ahol Assange túlzó ausztrál rockerként jelenik meg – fején nemzeti zászlós kendővel, tipikus ausztrál szlenggel élve – és politikai üzenetet közvetít John Farnham ‘You’re the Voice’ című slágerének paródiáján keresztül. A dalszövegek az átláthatóság fontosságára és a megfigyelés, valamint a politikai szófordulatok kifigurázására helyezik a hangsúlyt. A felvétel egy részét a nagykövetségen készítették.

A szatirikus videó az ausztrál politikusokat is kifigurázza – például Kevin Ruddot, Tony Abbottot és Julia Gillardot –, miközben Assange kampányát tárja a közönség elé, sőt a választásokat még a „Trónok harca” sorozathoz is hasonlítja.

A videó megjelenése egybeesik a WikiLeaks körüli hírekkel, különösen Chelsea Manning (korábban Bradley Manning) 35 éves börtönbüntetésével, mivel titkos amerikai dokumentumokat szivárogtatott ki. Assange-ot Svédország továbbra is körözi a 2010-es szexuális zaklatási vádak miatt, és nem hagyhatja el a nagykövetséget letartóztatás nélkül. Bár a WikiLeaks Párt színeiben indul szeptember 7-én Victoria állam szenátusi helyéért, jogi helyzete valószínűleg megakadályozza, hogy hivatalba lépjen. A WikiLeaks Párt országszerte hat jelöltet indított.

At the recent Coronation Festival held at Buckingham Palace, seven-year-old Jessica Fitch from Cheltenham created a memorable moment by asking Queen Elizabeth II to pose for a photo with her cherished teddy bear, Bertie. With her father Michael’s encouragement, Jessica made the bold request—a rarity, as palace sources admitted such a direct appeal was unprecedented. Not stopping there, Jessica also approached Prince Charles and the Duchess of Cornwall, Camilla, collecting photos with them as well.

As a proud Brownie, Jessica had brought along her group’s mascot, Bertie, to the festival. When the Queen noticed Bertie’s Brownie uniform, she asked Jessica if she was a member, and Jessica responded with confidence. Michael Fitch, an RAF officer, recounted how his daughter’s fearlessness helped secure this unique royal memory.

The Coronation Festival commemorated Queen Elizabeth’s 60th anniversary on the throne, showcasing over 200 British brands—Royal Warrant holders who have supplied goods or services to the Royal Household for at least five years. The four-day event attracted around 60,000 visitors and featured vibrant pavilions, performances, and a special gala, with celebrities like Dame Kiri Te Kanawa and Katherine Jenkins entertaining the crowd.

Various royal family members, including Princesses Beatrice and Eugenie, Zara Phillips, and the Earl and Countess of Wessex, joined attendees and visited exhibitor stands. The lively atmosphere celebrated both tradition and innovation within British culture and industry.

Notably, Welsh designer Julien Macdonald praised the Queen as exceptionally stylish and revealed how Buckingham Palace inspired his costume designs for the English National Ballet’s royal performance. Macdonald’s creations combined classic palace-inspired motifs with modern glamour, capturing the spirit of the celebration.

Overall, the Coronation Festival underscored Britain’s legacy of quality, creativity, and royal tradition, while also highlighting the warmth and accessibility of the Royal Family.

article_content: After the COVID-19 pandemic forced him to shut down his vegetable business, 27-year-old Rishabh Sharma turned to online work-from-home scams. Police say he is responsible for defrauding people of about Rs 21 crore over six months, with victims spread across ten Indian states. Sharma reportedly used a list of phone numbers to randomly approach individuals with deceptive job offers. Investigators found Sharma directly involved in 37 cases and complicit in another 855. Authorities believe he worked alongside international criminal groups, transferring the illicit proceeds to places such as China, Singapore, Hong Kong, and Dubai through informal financial channels and cryptocurrency. In one recent instance, a businessman in Dehradun was duped after being approached by someone impersonating a Marriott Bonvoy hotel representative via WhatsApp. Convinced by a fake job offer, the victim was persuaded to invest close to Rs 20 lakh. After initially receiving a small payment, he invested more, only to lose contact with Sharma and his partners. Police arrested Sharma after tracking his bank accounts and used a national cybercrime database to link him to numerous fraud cases. Authorities are continuing their investigation, focusing on Sharma’s connections to broader international networks and the methods used to siphon money abroad. The case underlines the expanding risk of advanced online job scams in India.

Sharma állítólag egy telefonszám-adatbázist használt, hogy véletlenszerűen keressen meg embereket hamis állásajánlatokkal. A nyomozók szerint Sharma 37 ügyben közvetlenül volt érintett, további 855-ben pedig segédkezett. A hatóságok úgy gondolják, hogy nemzetközi bűnszövetkezetekkel dolgozott együtt, és jogtalanul szerzett pénzeket informális csatornákon és kriptovalután keresztül jutattak el Kínába, Szingapúrba, Hongkongba és Dubajba. Egy közelmúltbeli esetben egy dehraduni üzletembert csaptak be, miután egy magát Marriott Bonvoy szállodalánc képviselőjének kiadó csaló kereste meg WhatsAppon. Az áldozatot egy hamis munkalehetőséggel vették rá, hogy csaknem 2 millió rúpiát fektessen be. Miután egy kisebb összeget visszakapott, további befektetéseket hajtott végre, de később sem Sharmával, sem társaival nem tudta felvenni a kapcsolatot. A rendőrség Sharmát bankszámláinak felkutatása után tartóztatta le, és egy országos kiberbűnözési adatbázissal kötötte össze rengeteg csalási üggyel. A hatóságok tovább folytatják a vizsgálatot Sharma nemzetközi kapcsolatai és a pénzek külföldre juttatásának módszerei iránt. Az ügy rávilágít a kifinomult online álláscsalások növekvő veszélyére Indiában.

article_content: Nicknamed ‘Ray Donovan’ by his Southampton teammates, Harrison Reed is recognized for resolving difficult situations in central midfield—a nod to the TV character famed for problem-solving. Reed made a mark in his first Barclays Premier League start by hustling the ball out of play 17 minutes in, earning loud support from the home fans. Only 19, Reed stood out for his assured and energetic display, anchoring the team’s defense in their win over Everton. With first-choice midfielders Morgan Schneiderlin and Victor Wanyama suspended and Jack Cork out injured, Reed stepped up, showing persistence and sharp passing that fueled Southampton’s victory, ending a five-match losing streak. Teammate Shane Long noted, 'I call him Ray Donovan because he cleans up everything in midfield. With so much quality here, breaking into the team is tough, but he was immense.' Goals from Graziano Pelle, Maya Yoshida, and an own goal by Everton’s Romelu Lukaku secured the win, but much of it began with Reed’s midfield control. Manager Ronald Koeman commented, 'He’s not the most technical, but his spirit and character in midfield battles were outstanding. He played very well in front of our center backs—his best position.' Though defensive midfielders rarely get the spotlight, Reed’s impressive performance lifted Southampton’s spirits and helped them return to winning ways.

Az első Premier League-kezdőjén már a 17. percben felhívta magára a figyelmet, amikor kivágta a labdát, amivel nagy tapsot kapott a St Mary’s nézőitől. Mindössze 19 évesen Reed magabiztos és energikus játékkal stabilizálta a védelmet, hozzájárulva a Southampton Everton elleni győzelméhez. Mivel a megszokott középpályások (Morgan Schneiderlin és Victor Wanyama) eltiltottak voltak, Jack Cork pedig sérült, Reed kapott lehetőséget, és szorgalma, illetve pontos passzai segítettek megtörni az ötmeccses vereségsorozatot. Csapattársa, Shane Long azt mondta róla: 'Azért hívom őt Ray Donovannak, mert mindent rendbe tesz a középpályán. Nehéz bejutni ebbe a minőségi csapatba, de ő ragadta meg az alkalmat és kiváló volt.' Ronald Koeman edző így értékelt: 'Nem ő a legtechnikásabb, de óriási szellemet és karaktert mutatott a középpályás csatákban. A legjobb posztján, a védők előtt futballozott, és ezt kifogástalanul oldotta meg.' Bár a védekező középpályásokat ritkán emelik ki, Reed játéka nagyban hozzájárult a Southampton sikeréhez.

Supporters of Julian Assange lost £200,000 in bail contributions after he violated conditions by seeking refuge in Ecuador’s London embassy. Notable backers—such as Jemima Khan, John Pilger, Ken Loach, and Felix Dennis—had paid significant sums to secure his release while he fought extradition to Sweden over denied sexual assault allegations. Following his escape in June, another £140,000 from nine other individuals, including Nobel Prize-winning biologist Sir John Sulston and environmental campaigner Tracy Worcester, is now at risk unless Assange surrenders. 

At Westminster Magistrates Court, Judge Riddle observed that none of these supporters attended the hearing, with some citing overseas commitments or holidays. Assange’s lawyers contended the backers could not have anticipated or stopped his actions, as his decision to seek asylum was unexpected. Police explained they were unable to enter the embassy without invitation, despite knowing his location.

Before entering the embassy, Assange was obligated to stay at Sarah Saunders’ home in Kent every night, report daily to police, and comply with an electronic curfew. He now faces arrest if he leaves the embassy, stating he fears extradition to the US for his WikiLeaks disclosures. Assange remains inside, intent on not leaving until the Swedish case is dropped.

Olyan ismert támogatók, mint Jemima Khan, John Pilger, Ken Loach és Felix Dennis jelentős összegeket fizettek ki, hogy biztosítsák Assange szabadon bocsátását, miközben kiadatása ellen harcolt Svédországba, ahol nemi erőszakkal vádolják, amit tagad.

Miután júniusban megszegte az óvadék feltételeit, további 140 000 font veszett veszélybe kilenc másik támogató részéről – köztük Sir John Sulston Nobel-díjas biológus és Tracy Worcester környezetvédő –, hacsak Assange nem adja fel magát a rendőrségen.

A Westminsteri Magisztrátusi Bíróságon Judge Riddle megjegyezte, hogy ténylegesen egyik támogató sem jelent meg a tárgyaláson; páran külföldi elfoglaltságot vagy nyaralást jeleztek okként. Assange korábban minden éjszakát Sarah Saunders kent-i otthonában kellett töltenie, naponta jelentkeznie a rendőrségen, és betartania egy elektronikus kijárási tilalmat. Most azzal fenyegetik letartóztatással, ha elhagyja a nagykövetséget, mivel attól tart, hogy kiadják az Egyesült Államoknak a WikiLeaks kiszivárogtatásai miatt. Assange azt állítja, addig marad, amíg Svédország ejti az ellene felhozott vádakat.

China announced on Friday that it will grant visa-free entry for citizens of France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Spain, and Malaysia as part of a one-year trial starting December 1. Travelers from these countries can enter China for up to 15 days without a visa, aiming to encourage business and tourism visits. The decision, according to Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning, is intended to support the "high-quality development of Chinese and foreign personnel exchanges and high-level opening up to the outside world."

During the pandemic, China enforced strict entry restrictions, including mandatory quarantines, discouraging international travel for nearly three years. Although these measures were lifted earlier this year, inbound travel has not yet recovered to pre-pandemic levels. Previously, China offered visa-free entry to citizens from Brunei, Japan, and Singapore, but this was suspended due to COVID-19. The policy resumed for Brunei and Singapore in July, but not for Japan.

Official data shows that, in the first six months of this year, China recorded 8.4 million entries and exits by foreigners—far below the 977 million for all of 2019.

The EU Chamber of Commerce in China welcomed the new visa policy, describing it as "a tangible and practical improvement, which will also increase business confidence." China is actively seeking more foreign investment to support its economy. High-profile business leaders, such as Tesla's Elon Musk and Apple's Tim Cook, have visited the country recently. However, foreign tourist numbers remain low compared to pre-pandemic times.

Az érintett országokból érkezők legfeljebb 15 napig tartózkodhatnak Kínában vízum nélkül, ezzel ösztönözve az üzleti és turisztikai célú látogatásokat. A járvány idején Kína szigorú beutazási korlátozásokat vezetett be, köztük kötelező karantént, ami majdnem három évig visszavetette a nemzetközi utazást. Az Európai Unió Kereskedelmi Kamarája üdvözölte az új vízumrendeletet, amelyet „kézzelfogható és gyakorlati előrelépésnek” nevezett, ami növeli az üzleti bizalmat.
